name: Babel: English + 2% cuneiform
aim: Pan on the same English plus cuneiform at 1.92% of the bytes (ETCSL and CDLI Sumerian): does the non-English script begin to bias English?
opt_in: The Babel expedition (Justin, 8 November): cuneiform transliterations are discovery text, not an English recipe; Pan is read on English with and without a measured cuneiform share.
